references.text: Moses' leadership of the people of Israel in the wilderness, and how they trusted in God's providence.
A similar situation where the disciples ask Jesus to send the crowds away to buy food, but Jesus performs a miracle instead.
The disciples advise Jesus to send the crowd away to find food and lodging, which mirrors the situation in Mark.
Jesus performs a similar miracle by feeding 5,000 men, plus women and children, from five barley loaves and two fish.
